round: Answers the tester's failure at b3e92f8b and the architect's ACCEPT decision (the remaining part of review finding 4 alone): an interest registered for another session's agent subject, or a wildcard covering agent subjects, let /v1/replay return other sessions' stored inboxes.

proof.criterion: Review finding 4: /v1/replay can return only the caller's own agent subject and topics it may follow, through /v1/interests/subscribe
proof.surface: a real listener and natsd built from this head, called over HTTP
proof.observed: ses_attacker registered notifications.agent.>, notifications.agent.ses_victim, notifications.> and notifications.dispatch.issue.KEY-1.>: only its own agent subject and the issue topic were stored, the other three named in warnings; two messages sent to ses_victim; ses_attacker's replay of notifications.agent.>, notifications.agent.ses_victim and notifications.> each refused not_followed with no messages; ses_victim's own replay returned its 2 messages
proof.negativeControl: before the fix (466c24da) the tester's live run had the same registrations return the victim's 2 stored messages through both notifications.agent.> and the victim's agent subject (test.json failures[0])

proof.criterion: Review finding 4 for rows already in the interest store
proof.surface: the listener route on in-process nats-server (testnats) with the interest store seeded directly
proof.command: cd packages/envoy && go test ./cmd/listener -run TestReplayNeverReturnsAnotherSessionsInboxThroughARegisteredInterest -count=1 -v (the tester's 9f8ac8ff, unmodified)
proof.observed: --- PASS: the three out-of-bounds subjects are refused with no other session's message, and the own agent subject returns its stored seq
proof.negativeControl: at b3e92f8b the same test failed: notifications.agent.> returned notifications.agent.ses_other's stored message (seq 1)

proof.criterion: No regression of the outage paths on a real session (pi-envoy and claude-envoy now leave such topics out of what they register)
proof.surface: real `omp --mode rpc` session, real nats-server with JetStream and the listener built from this head
proof.observed: legs 1-6 each show every event exactly once (connection cut, omp stopped, held through SIGKILL, abort_and_restore_queue, plain abort, switch away and back); exit 0
proof.negativeControl: released plugin 10.17.7 in the same run loses its messages on the outage, SIGKILL and interrupt paths

filesChanged: packages/envoy/internal/bus/stored.go (+ test): CoversAnotherAgentSubject(sessionID, topic), on the existing subjectsOverlap
packages/envoy/cmd/listener/replay.go: replayFollowed refuses such a subject even when stored
packages/envoy/cmd/listener/api.go: subscribeHandler stores the rest and names each refused topic in warnings

packages/envoy/cmd/listener/replay_test.go: TestInterestSubscribeStoresOnlyTopicsThatReplayCannotTurnIntoAnotherSessionsInbox; TestReplayRefusesAFollowedSubjectTheStreamDoesNotRetain now uses notifications.* as its wide unretained topic
packages/envoy-client/src/replay.ts (+ test): coversAnotherAgentSubject; replayFollowedSubjects uses it
packages/pi-envoy/extensions/envoy.ts, packages/claude-envoy/src/envoy-channel-server.ts (+ tests, dist): such topics followed live but never registered
docs: packages/envoy/AGENTS.md, packages/envoy/docs/architecture.md, four CHANGELOGs; PR body contract change census
deviations: Per-topic refusal at /v1/interests/subscribe (200 with warnings), not a whole-request 400: pi-envoy 10.17.7, claude-envoy and the OpenCode plugin can send such a topic, and a 400 would fail every heartbeat registration of those sessions.

One existing test changed: TestReplayRefusesAFollowedSubjectTheStreamDoesNotRetain used notifications.> as its unretained topic, which the new rule refuses as not_followed; it now uses notifications.*; notifications.> is asserted in the new subscribe test.
Rows stored before the upgrade stay in the interest store (replay refuses them); GET /v1/interests/<id> still lists them.
